principles.name: Evidence before confidence
principles.direction: Distinguish observed records, accepted advisory design and deployed product acceptance; never promote SDK completion or offline tests to green.

principles.name: Show the revision, not agent busyness
principles.direction: Order requirements, first design, actual findings, changed candidate and exact revised review; surface genuine gated decisions without inventing model approvals.

principles.name: Continuity without identity leakage
principles.direction: Use aliases in the human transcript; exact private bindings and hashes belong in the authorized evidence report. Aliases alone never prove continuity or access.

principles.name: Safety is visible
principles.direction: Unknown effects stay held. Retrieve a known response without resend; never offer reset, new-parent replacement or a retry as recovery of uncertain work.

principles.name: Current state, localized next action
principles.direction: Report seven components using fresh observations; unexecuted checks are amber. Name the unmet criterion and next owner without importing historical blockers.

toolsets.name: Existing Python terminal
toolsets.purpose: Keep --native --view human opt-in stderr projection and unchanged stdout records; no new GUI or service.

toolsets.name: Existing event and artifact contracts
toolsets.purpose: Use exact requirements/candidate revisions and real review findings; generated content remains data, not executable instructions.

toolsets.name: Existing acceptance evidence
toolsets.purpose: Join source-bound private observations; a plausible transcript or supplied JSON is not live provenance.

toolsets.name: Standard-library UX contract tests
toolsets.purpose: Validate scope, coverage, references, state/action gates and negative mutations without cloud calls or extra dependencies.

regions: Ordered actual architect/reviewer delegations and pinned version/response aliases
Current design, exact review, findings and coordinator outcome
Observed error or held status without speculative cause
Exact unmet criterion and supported next action; preserve private state
Exact source revision and observed runtime/run outcome
Intended environment and actually observed three deployed versions, otherwise NOT VERIFIED
Seven canonical component rows with evidence freshness and next action
Accepted work versus unresolved criteria; no release claim from advisory approval

flows.trigger: Submit a fresh synthetic private-ingress design request under genuine dedicated lab authentication.
flows.direction: Show ordered real calls and current revision. The authorized report exposes exact accepted artifact and decision refs; first findings and the changed candidate must be inspectable, not fabricated to fit a storyboard.
flows.return: ACCEPTED_ADVISORY only for current exact approved design; otherwise show actual input/hold/failure and its next action.

flows.trigger: Add an asynchronous queue to a completed same-parent request, or retrieve its persisted known pending response.
flows.direction: Keep private ingress and prior requirements, show new requirements/candidate/review revisions and stable alias observations without claiming exact continuity. Recovery is retrieval, not another delegation. Supported hosted-session stop/resume is acceptance-only, not a terminal reset button.
flows.return: Current advisory result after follow-up; recovery/stop-resume/isolation remain NOT VERIFIED until independent source-bound checks pass.

flows.trigger: Submit a distinct synthetic request as a genuinely independent second parent.
flows.direction: Use a distinct private state file and display separate aliases. Do not copy the first parent's context, children or artifact refs into the second request. Source-bound evidence must prove isolation; different aliases alone are insufficient.
flows.return: Separate authorized advisory output and explicit isolation verification status; never claim per-role storage RBAC isolation.

flows.trigger: Receive the committed skeleton or application candidate for existing-environment DevOps then E2E verification.
flows.direction: Identify candidate, actual azd outcome, observed three versions and separate deployed probes; show canonical component RAG. Never present uploaded code, a healthy host or local schema success as a released product.
flows.return: Exact candidate deployed evidence or localized unmet criteria; no dependent release on offline work.

states.display: Synthetic request ready; no remote outcome observed.
Observed machine stream; no accepted human summary before a complete validated result and persisted finalization.
Current approved design and review, not release acceptance.
REQUEST_INPUT with actual decision reason as data; only a real missing user fact calls for input.
ROUTING_HOLD: semantic choice not accepted; inspect current routing evidence, not an automatic user-approval request.
LIMIT_REACHED: no accepted design/release; preserve configured limits and accepted partial work.
Retrieve the exact saved response; retrieval is not a new invocation.
HELD: uncertain effect; preserve private state and reconcile using supported evidence. Missing logs/404/process do not prove never sent.
BLOCKED: observed code, no accepted summary; name the failed boundary and leave cause unknown unless demonstrated.
